<div className="router-provider-coverage-marker" />

Comfy Router uses one endpoint for every model: `POST /v2/models/{provider}/{model}`. Comfy serves each model by default. Alternate providers use the same model ID, request body, and response format. See [`model_provider`, `strict_mode` and `fallback_provider`](/development/comfy-router/reference#post-v2modelsprovidermodel) in the API reference.

<Note>
To use Comfy, omit `model_provider`. To choose an alternate provider, add `?model_provider=<provider>`. The matrix compares every model with alternate-provider coverage.
</Note>

```python Python
from comfy_sdk import Comfy

# Reads COMFY_API_KEY from the environment.
# The SDK automatically creates an idempotency key and reuses it for automatic retries.
with Comfy() as client:
    result = client.models.run(
        "byteplus/dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128",
        {
            "content": [
                {
                    "text": "A red fox trotting through a snowy pine forest",
                    "type": "text",
                },
            ],
            "duration": 5,
            "ratio": "16:9",
            "resolution": "720p",
        },
        model_provider="fal",
    )

print(result)
```

```typescript TypeScript
import { comfy } from "@comfyorg/sdk";

// Reads COMFY_API_KEY from the environment.
// The SDK automatically creates an idempotency key and reuses it for automatic retries.
const result = await comfy.models.run("byteplus/dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128", {
  content: [
    {
      text: "A red fox trotting through a snowy pine forest",
      type: "text",
    },
  ],
  duration: 5,
  ratio: "16:9",
  resolution: "720p",
}, {
  modelProvider: "fal",
});
console.log(result.data);
```

```swift Swift
import Foundation
import ComfySwiftSDK

// Reads COMFY_API_KEY from the environment.
// The SDK mints an idempotency key per call and reuses it for automatic retries.
let client = ComfyCloudClient(apiKey: ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["COMFY_API_KEY"]!)
let result = try await client.models.run(
    "byteplus/dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128",
    input: [
        "content": [
            [
                "text": "A red fox trotting through a snowy pine forest",
                "type": "text",
            ],
        ],
        "duration": 5,
        "ratio": "16:9",
        "resolution": "720p",
    ],
    modelProvider: "fal"
)

print(result.output)
```

```bash cURL
curl https://api.comfy.org/v2/models/byteplus/dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128?model_provider=fal \
  -H "X-API-Key: $COMFY_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"content\": [{\"text\":\"A red fox trotting through a snowy pine forest\",\"type\":\"text\"}], \"duration\": 5, \"ratio\": \"16:9\", \"resolution\": \"720p\"}"
```

Provider selection works on synchronous calls. The queued `/requests` route does not accept `model_provider`; see the [queued delivery guide](/development/comfy-router/queue) for queued requests.

## Request compatibility

When `strict_mode=false` (the default), Router translates the native request for the selected provider and translates the response back. If a native field cannot be represented, Router drops it and names it in the `X-Comfy-Router-Dropped-Params` response header. See [`model_provider`, `strict_mode` and `fallback_provider`](/development/comfy-router/reference#post-v2modelsprovidermodel) for the other routing options.
